title: Collapsible macOS sidebar that remembers its state; one shared phone sheet; week start as a sheet
context: The prototype adds a collapsible macOS sidebar (176 to 68 points, Cmd-backslash) not in the summary, and turns every phone pop-up into a bottom sheet while two live sheets (mood picker, capture chooser) each draw their own grabber; the design rules say any dropdown becomes a sheet on the phone.
options: one shared sheet and move both existing sheets
shared sheet for new ones only
outcome: The sidebar collapses and the choice is saved under the settings key sidebar_collapsed; the streak becomes a one-line pill. One PhoneSheet serves every phone sheet and the mood picker and chooser move onto it. The phone week-start control opens the shared sheet; macOS keeps its menu.
